ticket.title: Add a --names-only option ({run})
ticket.body:
Bench scenario S4 (throwaway).

## Spec

Add a `--names-only` option to the CLI: it prints one place name per line, with no distance and no count line. Without the option the output is unchanged. Expose it in `accessplaces/cli.py` (the search logic is untouched). Add a unit test in `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Acceptance

- `python -m accessplaces cafe --names-only` prints the two cafe names, one per line, and nothing else.
- Existing output is unchanged. Tests pass.
